messages.subject: Project Atlas - completion accounts / earn-out query
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

Sorry to land this with you mid-flow on other things. On Project Atlas (the Brampton Leisure acquisition), our finance team and Harland Vesey are not aligned on one item in the completion accounts - the treatment of the deferred maintenance accrual - which feeds into the earn-out. Could we grab 20 minutes this week to work out whether it's worth disputing under the SPA mechanism?

No great urgency but I'd like to close it off before quarter-end.

Thanks,
Nathan

Nathan Reilly | Head of M&A | Kingsford Group Limited
